policy.intro: Your privacy is our priority. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.

collected.title: Collected Data:
collected.text: We only collect the data necessary to use our services: name, surname, email, date of birth, and medical information if applicable.

usage.text: The data is used to personalize your experience, allow you to access your account, and improve our services.

sharing.text: No data will be sold or shared with third parties without your explicit consent, except when legally required.
